title: Stewardship -- who owns an installed path's bytes, and what each cell of a three-way reading means

digest.description: Whether a digest of these paths MEANS anything. `not-taken` is a declared absence of a measurement -- a directory the host fills has no bytes of its own, and the estate cannot record a digest of itself. The estate writes null there, and null is never read as a value.

cells.description: One verdict per cell. WHICH cell a path is in is computed from three digests and is a finite, DERIVED space; what a cell MEANS is policy and lives here. A cell the reconciler computes and this table does not answer is refused at the moment it is met -- never defaulted, because a default is how a reconciliation acquires a rule nobody declared.

cell.description: Which of the three-way readings this row answers. The space is FINITE and DERIVED -- three readings, each present, absent or changed -- so it is enumerated here, where the contract between the reconciler and this declaration belongs. It is not an open registry and must not pretend to be one: a cell nobody can compute is a rule that certifies.

state.description: The word the surface prints for this reading. Distinct from the cell, on purpose: `advanced` under a host steward is `available`, because what happened to the path and what the operator must understand are two different statements.

file.description: What happens to the path. The words are the PLAN's own disposition vocabulary, which the interpreter provides and this declaration consumes -- restated here only because a schema is where a contract between the two is legible, and held to that one home by a gate rather than by care.

record.description: What happens to the ROW, which is a separate axis from what happens to the file: a path can be kept on disk and dropped from the account, or left untouched and have its digest advanced. Collapsing the two is how a file the kit stopped shipping becomes an unexplained path in a governed plane.

adoptable.description: This refusal is one a NAMED HUMAN may accept, and the cell it becomes when they do. Absent means the refusal stands whoever is asking -- a structural contradiction is not a thing anyone has the standing to wave through, and a flag that could wave it through would be an exemption field on a gate. Adoption is not that: it is a door, and it leaves a name, a moment and the digest it superseded on the row itself.
